findings.reason: 0x00406220 cast as GetEngineConfigPtr_t and used to write width/height/bpp/gamma fields via IsBadWritePtr. igi.exe RE proves 0x406220 returns profile-record ptr (0xBC2388+0xD14*idx), NOT an engine-config struct - the writes land on wrong fields of the profile record. Critical correctness bug.
PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE on two data doubles (FOV globals); PAGE_READWRITE suffices and is safer.
FOV_GET reads *(double*)0x005335E8 unguarded while sibling functions guard it - crash if image unmapped.
Status-display helper calls hooked StatusMsg entry instead of StatusMsgOut trampoline -> re-enters detour recursively from render paths.
Overlay rendered once per SKINNED MESH not per frame; GetTickCount gate leaks mid-frame passes (10-16ms tick). Move to hkBinocularsDraw only.
g_improved_map/g_improved_binoculars are plain bool written by hotkey thread, read by game-thread detours - needs atomic<bool> + matching externs.
SCRIPT::PARSE std::strcpy into 0x94-byte block with no bound - buffer overflow on long qsc path. Use bounded copy (limit ~0x80 bytes before mem_blk[0x20]).
RESTART casts 0x00402820 as cleanup(int) and calls cleanup(0x1E) - we PROVED 0x402820 is FramesSet, so this silently sets 30 FPS. Remove the call or make it explicit MISC::FRAMES_SET(30).
